source.quote: SMSL's own page for the DO100 Pro, read 2026-11-24: « ES9039Q2M*2 Supports MQA decoding and MQA-CD »; « The brand-new third-generation XMOS XU-316, supports up to PCM 32bit/768kHz and DSD512 »; « Input ports (except Bluetooth) support MQA and DSD, coaxial and optical support DoP64 ».

facts.chip: TWO ES9039Q2M (ESS) - « ES9039Q2M*2 » - against the single one of smsl/d-6s, which is the same part in one and two copies on two models of one maker.
